tool.name: Barcode Splitter
tool.description: Split FASTQ files using barcodes as criteria

param.name: BARCODES
param.label: Barcode file
param.help: Tab-delimited file with identifiers and barcodes. First column is identifier, subsequent columns are barcodes.

param.name: mismatches
param.label: Number of allowed mismatches
param.help: Number of mismatches allowed per barcode (default: 0)

tool.help:
# Barcode Splitter
## What it does Splits a FASTQ file into multiple files based on barcodes. Creates separate files for unmatched and multimatched reads.
## Input Requirements - Input FASTQ file - Barcode file (tab-delimited with identifiers and barcodes)
## Output - Summary table of split counts - Directory of split FASTQ files
## Barcode File Format ``` # comments start with # Sample1 GATCT TTGCAT Sample2 ATCGT GCGCAT ```
